tasks.old_behavior: When metadata buffer size overflow (integer wraparound) is detected, an error message 'Metadata buffer size overflow.' is logged without any diagnostic details.
tasks.new_behavior: When metadata buffer size overflow is detected, the error message includes the actual size values (size, size2) and the device name, formatted as 'Metadata buffer size overflow %zu + %zu on %s.'.
tasks.compatibility_reason: The error message format for metadata buffer overflow has changed. Any tool, script, monitoring system, or test that parses lvm stderr/log output and matches against the exact error string 'Metadata buffer size overflow.' will fail to match the new message. The message now includes size values and device name which changes both the text and number of tokens.
tasks.test_recommendation: Verify that the new error message format includes the correct size and device name. Compile the patched binary and trigger the metadata buffer overflow condition (by passing a crafted metadata size that causes integer wraparound) to confirm the new message format.
